selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What is the main message of this passage?
questions.answer: All the prophets together point to Allah’s existence and oneness.

questions.question: Which group of people is spoken about in this passage?
questions.answer: All the prophets.

questions.question: What do the prophets agree on?
questions.answer: They agree that Allah alone is God.

questions.question: What makes their message strong in this passage?
questions.answer: Their miracles make it strong.

questions.question: What do the miracles do for the prophets’ message?
questions.answer: They support it and show it is true.

questions.question: What does the agreement of all the prophets show about Allah?
questions.answer: It shows that Allah must exist and that He is One.

questions.question: Why is the prophets’ united agreement important?
questions.answer: When all of them say the same truth, it becomes very strong and trustworthy.

questions.question: What is the best summary of the proof in this passage?
questions.answer: The united message of all prophets, backed by miracles, shows Allah’s existence and oneness.

questions.question: Who gives witness in this passage?
questions.answer: All the prophets give witness.

questions.question: What truth are they witnessing to?
questions.answer: They are witnessing that Allah exists and has no partner.

questions.question: How are the prophets described as being together in their message?
questions.answer: They are completely united.

questions.question: What kind of signs are connected to the prophets here?
questions.answer: Bright and amazing miracles.

questions.question: How do these signs help people believe the prophets?
questions.answer: They confirm that the prophets are sent with truth.

questions.question: What does it mean that the prophets are unanimous?
questions.answer: It means they all agree without going against one another.

questions.question: What two big ideas about Allah are proven in this passage?
questions.answer: His necessary existence and His oneness.

questions.question: Which is emphasized more here: disagreement or harmony among the prophets?
questions.answer: Harmony among the prophets is emphasized.

questions.question: According to this passage, what statement about Allah is being declared?
questions.answer: That there is no god except Allah.

questions.question: Which people are named as agreeing with this statement?
questions.answer: All the prophets.

questions.question: Is the passage speaking about only some prophets or every prophet together?
questions.answer: It speaks about every prophet together.

questions.question: What gives power to their testimony?
questions.answer: Their shining miracles give power to it.

questions.question: What is one job of those miracles?
questions.answer: They prove the prophets are truthful.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the relationship between prophets and miracles?
questions.answer: The miracles are signs that support the prophets’ mission.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about Allah’s unity?
questions.answer: It teaches that Allah is One and all prophets point to that truth.

questions.question: If all prophets teach the same core truth, what does that tell us about their call?
questions.answer: Their call is united and dependable.
